objective: Separate RMSNormGated shape dependence from FP8 out_proj shape dependence after R91's combined output-stage isolation regressed c1.

variants.implementation: Apply RMSNormGated independently at each natural request row count, concatenate normalized rows, and invoke the existing FP8 out_proj once on the packed rows.
Apply RMSNormGated once on packed rows, then invoke the existing FP8 out_proj independently at each natural request row count and concatenate projected rows.

fixed_workload.sequence: For each variant on a fresh server and compile cache, run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2.

interpretation_rules.c1_regression: Reject the variant; moving this stage behind a custom-op boundary changes the accepted single-request numerical path.
interpretation_rules.c1_pass_c2_fail: The isolated stage is not sufficient; retain only as localization evidence.
interpretation_rules.c1_and_c2_pass: Candidate diagnostic repair only; require a non-tracing production-lineage build plus the full strict varied-prompt battery and clean-boot replay before promotion.

promotion_boundary: Diagnostic factorial only. No site, README, headline, protected-speed, recipe-default, or LocalMaxxing authority. This boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
